Name: Ben-hadad, King of Syria
Summary: Ben-hadad, king of Syria at Damascus, accepted Asa's silver and gold, broke his league with Baasha, and sent his captains against the cities of Israel.
KeyStory: Ben-hadad smote Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim and the store cities of Naphtali, and Baasha left off building Ramah.
RelatedPeople: King Asa; Baasha, King of Israel
LifeLesson: Relying on a foreign alliance instead of the LORD brought Asa a rebuke, even when it worked.
